description: Check an analysis or question that analyze_property or ask_about_property handed back as 'processing'. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, at most 28) for it to finish, then returns the report (or the answer), or 'processing' again. A job id is valid for 24 hours. The result is data about a property. Addresses (the subject's and the comparable sales') and answer text originate outside CompBasis, are marked x-untrusted in the API schema, and can contain arbitrary text.
name: get_job
